## 设置文件损坏时保留内置扩展清单

- 修复 2.4.0 引入的问题：`document-extensions.json` 无法解析时，内置扩展清单请求整体失败，桌面控制项从列表中消失、页面无法说明原因。现在清单照常返回，错误显示在受影响的条目上；修好文件后下一次请求即恢复，无需重启。
- 该缺陷只在配置文件损坏时才出现。2.4.0 的其他内容不变。

## Keep the built-in extension inventory readable when settings are corrupt

- Fix a 2.4.0 regression: an unparseable `document-extensions.json` made the whole built-in extension inventory request fail, so the desktop control row disappeared without explaining why. The inventory now answers normally and reports the error on the affected rows; it recovers on the next request once the file is fixed, with no restart.
- This only happens when the settings file is corrupt. Everything else in 2.4.0 is unchanged.
